**The merge block** (`sql/20-identity-merge.sql`, in section A):

```sql
  -- ════ spec §12 (the addenda): every user column of Q's, Z's, C's, K's and P's ends and of
  --      sections M N V U J H B G E T joins the merge (checks ME64, I17, MG*, M0-M7, MS*) ════
  -- ── meeting addendum (design.md §9): sections Q's and C's end, K's end, M, V, T ──
  if to_regclass('public.study_questions') is not null then
    update public.study_questions set checked_by = dst where checked_by = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_cards') is not null then
    update public.study_cards set checked_by = dst where checked_by = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_edit_proposals') is not null then
    update public.study_edit_proposals set proposed_by = dst where proposed_by = src;
    update public.study_edit_proposals set approved_by = dst where approved_by = src;
    update public.study_edits set approved_by = dst where approved_by = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_meetings') is not null then
    update public.study_meetings set created_by = dst where created_by = src;
    update public.study_meetings set updated_by = dst where updated_by = src;
    update public.study_meetings set planned_reader = dst where planned_reader = src;
    update public.study_meetings set reader_id = dst where reader_id = src;
    update public.study_meeting_events set created_by = dst where created_by = src;
    -- one "לא ברור" a paragraph a meeting: the account's stays
    delete from public.study_meeting_taps s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_meeting_taps d
                    where d.user_id = dst and d.meeting_id = s.meeting_id and d.part_idx = s.part_idx and d.anchor = s.anchor);
    update public.study_meeting_taps set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    -- presence: one row a meeting, the earlier first and the later last
    update public.study_meeting_presence d set first_at = least(d.first_at, s.first_at), last_at = greatest(d.last_at, s.last_at)
      from public.study_meeting_presence s
     where s.user_id = src and d.user_id = dst and d.meeting_id = s.meeting_id;
    delete from public.study_meeting_presence s
     where s.user_id = src and exists (select 1 from public.study_meeting_presence d where d.user_id = dst and d.meeting_id = s.meeting_id);
    update public.study_meeting_presence set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    delete from public.study_meeting_guess_answers s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_meeting_guess_answers d
                    where d.user_id = dst and d.meeting_id = s.meeting_id and d.question_id = s.question_id);
    update public.study_meeting_guess_answers set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    delete from public.study_meeting_catchups s
     where s.user_id = src and exists (select 1 from public.study_meeting_catchups d where d.user_id = dst and d.meeting_id = s.meeting_id);
    update public.study_meeting_catchups set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_disputes') is not null then
    update public.study_disputes set author_a = dst where author_a = src;
    update public.study_disputes set author_b = dst where author_b = src;
    update public.study_disputes set decided_by = dst where decided_by = src;
    delete from public.study_dispute_backs s
     where s.user_id = src and exists (select 1 from public.study_dispute_backs d where d.user_id = dst and d.dispute_id = s.dispute_id);
    update public.study_dispute_backs set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    update public.study_slide_flags set created_by = dst where created_by = src;
    update public.study_slide_flags set removed_by = dst where removed_by = src;
    delete from public.study_updates s
     where s.user_id = src and exists (select 1 from public.study_updates d where d.user_id = dst and d.edit_id = s.edit_id);
    update public.study_updates set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_member_prefs') is not null then
    delete from public.study_member_prefs s
     where s.user_id = src and exists (select 1 from public.study_member_prefs d where d.user_id = dst and d.group_id = s.group_id);
    update public.study_member_prefs set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;

  -- ── addendum "fun": the pulse (U), the wall (J), the boss (H) ──
  if to_regclass('public.study_pulse_optout') is not null then
    -- Out of the pulse on either device: the account stays out.
    delete from public.study_pulse_optout s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_pulse_optout d where d.group_id = s.group_id and d.user_id = dst);
    update public.study_pulse_optout set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_aids') is not null then
    -- One vote of each kind per person and entry: where both voted, one stays and the total drops by one.
    update public.study_aids a
       set funny_n = greatest(0, a.funny_n - x.f), stuck_n = greatest(0, a.stuck_n - x.s)
      from (select v.aid_id, count(*) filter (where v.kind = 'funny') as f, count(*) filter (where v.kind = 'stuck') as s
              from public.study_aid_votes v
             where v.user_id = src
               and exists (select 1 from public.study_aid_votes d where d.aid_id = v.aid_id and d.kind = v.kind and d.user_id = dst)
             group by v.aid_id) x
     where a.id = x.aid_id;
    delete from public.study_aid_votes v
     where v.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_aid_votes d where d.aid_id = v.aid_id and d.kind = v.kind and d.user_id = dst);
    update public.study_aid_votes set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    update public.study_aid_authors set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    -- Nobody votes for their own entry: a vote one device gave the other's entry goes.
    update public.study_aids a
       set funny_n = greatest(0, a.funny_n - x.f), stuck_n = greatest(0, a.stuck_n - x.s)
      from (select v.aid_id, count(*) filter (where v.kind = 'funny') as f, count(*) filter (where v.kind = 'stuck') as s
              from public.study_aid_votes v
              join public.study_aid_authors w on w.aid_id = v.aid_id and w.user_id = v.user_id
             where v.user_id = dst
             group by v.aid_id) x
     where a.id = x.aid_id;
    delete from public.study_aid_votes v
     using public.study_aid_authors w
     where w.aid_id = v.aid_id and w.user_id = v.user_id and v.user_id = dst;
    update public.study_aids set named_by = dst where named_by = src;
    update public.study_aids set credit_id = dst where credit_id = src;
    update public.study_aids set flagged_by = dst where flagged_by = src;
    -- Pins: one per paragraph; the account's stays.
    delete from public.study_aid_pins s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_aid_pins d
                    where d.user_id = dst and d.lecture_id = s.lecture_id and d.part_idx = s.part_idx and d.anchor = s.anchor);
    update public.study_aid_pins set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    update public.study_aid_credits set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_loot') is not null then
    delete from public.study_loot s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_loot d where d.user_id = dst and d.quiz_id = s.quiz_id and d.question_id = s.question_id);
    update public.study_loot set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;

  -- ── server addendum (design.md §8.4): Q's, C's and K's ends, B, G, E ──
  if to_regclass('public.study_questions') is not null then
    update public.study_questions set fixed_by = dst where fixed_by = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_card_adoptions') is not null then
    -- Parts both devices added stay added, once.
    delete from public.study_card_adoptions s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_card_adoptions d
                    where d.user_id = dst and d.lecture_id = s.lecture_id and d.part_idx = s.part_idx);
    update public.study_card_adoptions set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_my_cards') is not null then
    -- One private card per question and per thread: the one with more reviews stays.
    delete from public.study_my_cards s
     where s.user_id = src
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_my_cards d
                    where d.user_id = dst and d.reps >= s.reps
                      and ((s.question_id is not null and d.question_id = s.question_id)
                           or (s.comment_id is not null and d.comment_id = s.comment_id)));
    delete from public.study_my_cards d
     where d.user_id = dst
       and exists (select 1 from public.study_my_cards s
                    where s.user_id = src
                      and ((s.question_id is not null and d.question_id = s.question_id)
                           or (s.comment_id is not null and d.comment_id = s.comment_id)));
    update public.study_my_cards set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    update public.study_my_card_reviews set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
  end if;
  update public.study_comments set resolved_by = dst where resolved_by = src;
  if to_regclass('study_private.bank_jobs') is not null then
    update study_private.bank_jobs set requested_by = dst where requested_by = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_group_plans') is not null then
    update public.study_group_plans set created_by = dst where created_by = src;
    update public.study_group_plans set updated_by = dst where updated_by = src;
  end if;
  if to_regclass('public.study_trap_drafts') is not null then
    update public.study_trap_drafts set user_id = dst where user_id = src;
    update public.study_questions set author_id = dst where author_id = src;
  end if;
```

**K's checks' helper** (`edits/k_helper.sql`, after K's checks set `gid`):

```sql

-- meeting addendum: an applied edit is now a proposal plus a second
-- approval (section K's end). This helper does both, as the caller and then
-- as another member, and raises what either step raises (a paragraph that
-- changed meanwhile comes back from the approval as "conflict").
reset role;
create schema if not exists mtest;
grant usage on schema mtest to authenticated, anon;
create or replace function mtest.edit_block(p_lecture uuid, p_part int, p_anchor int, p_before text, p_after text,
  p_base_rev int, p_base_gen int, p_occurrence int default 1, p_note text default '', p_undo_of uuid default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql as $f$
declare
  me  text := current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true);
  pid uuid;
  res jsonb;
begin
  if p_undo_of is not null then
    return public.study_edit_block(p_lecture, p_part, p_anchor, p_before, p_after, p_base_rev, p_base_gen, p_occurrence, p_note, p_undo_of);
  end if;
  pid := public.study_propose_edit(p_lecture, p_part, p_anchor, p_before, p_after, p_base_rev, p_base_gen, coalesce(p_occurrence, 1),
                                   p_note, 'external', '{}', null, 'בדיקה');
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',
                     case when me = 'bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' then 'cccccccc-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'
                          else 'bbbbbbbb-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' end, true);
  res := public.study_approve_edit(pid);
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', me, true);
  if coalesce((res ->> 'conflict')::boolean, false) then raise exception '%', res ->> 'reason'; end if;
  return res;
end;
$f$;
grant execute on function mtest.edit_block(uuid, int, int, text, text, int, int, int, text, uuid) to authenticated, anon;
```

### 12.10 Review log

Two adversarial reviews read the three designs (`spec/addendum/critique/security.md`, 15 findings; `critique/feasibility.md`, 19). Each finding was checked here against the designs' SQL and text before it was acted on; every one held. "Fixed" means changed in §12's SQL or text and covered by the checks named; the checks run in §12.8 (0 FAIL).

#### 12.10.1 Security and privacy (SEC)

| # | Severity · where | Finding | What §12 does | Checks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SEC-1 | **blocker** · K's end | the one-tap undo applies any text, with no source and no approval, once a paragraph has had one correction | **Fixed.** An undo is bound to the correction it undoes: only the paragraph's latest correction, not an undo itself, and only back to its own text (`bad undo`); the app calls `study_undo_edit(edit)`, which reads the texts; reverting further back is a new proposal | SR1a-SR1f, KA9, K16, K19 |
| SEC-2 | **blocker** · Q's end | one flag by the caller herself opens the fix sheet, which returns the key, also while a live quiz holds it | **Fixed.** The fix sheet and the fix open only for a **hidden** question (two members' counting flags) and never while a live quiz holds its key (`not flagged`, `in quiz`) | SR2a-SR2g, QS checks |
| SEC-3 | major · K's end + M | "approval aloud" needs only a self-made meeting | **Fixed.** `study_private.meeting_reads_live`: the reader of today's meeting on the lecture, reading, a place in the last minute, two other members following (`not live`); one's own proposal is never approved, aloud or not (`own proposal`) | SR3a-SR3e, KA6, M7, M7c, V7 |
| SEC-4 | major · M | anyone becomes "the reader" with one call: reads the counts, locks the reader out, releases every pre-guess | **Fixed.** No takeover of a live reading (`reading`; after a minute's silence, yes); a place must be a part and moves one part a call (`bad parts`); a guess is released only with two followers; the reader's card answers only a live reading (`not live`) | SR4a-SR4h, M4 |
| SEC-5 | major · M, Z's end | "3 לקפה" orders by the players' private right answers: with two players it shows the other's mistakes (20 of 20) | **Fixed.** The opening orders by the group's nightly signal, a teaser, chance; Z's "fewest seen by these players" only from 3 players | SR5a (0 of 20 runs), SR5b (5 of 20, chance 1 in 18) |
| SEC-6 | major · Z's end (from the spec) | counts below 3 answers, a solo quiz's score under the host's name, and an immediate trap card, all through the API | **Fixed.** Counts, rights and "לא יודעים" from 3 answers, to players only; the end summary and the team score from 3; the recent list's score from 3 players; a trap card from 3 players' choice, opening at the next study day (`study_cards.opens_at`, its RLS and every list) | SR6a-SR6h, ZA7, N1, N2, QZ5c |
| SEC-7 | major · E + Q's end | a member's trap is unmasked by any member answering it in practice with `p_mode 'quiz'` | **Fixed.** `study_answer_question` refuses mode `quiz` (`bad mode`); the unmask runs in Z's reveal through the hook `study_quiz__revealed` (section E); the trigger on `study_answers` is gone | SR7, ES5a, ES5b |
| SEC-8 | major · U | "from 3 people" counts member ids: an opt-out between two nights, or a second device, reveals what one or two others did | **Fixed:** only saved accounts that joined a week before are counted; reading is reciprocal (an opted-out or uncounted member reads no pulse, spots, museum, "דרושות" or boss heads until a night counts her). **Not adopted:** raising the museum's and "sure"'s bar to 4 (decision 1 approved 3; §12.11 #6) | SR8a-SR8f, H1e |
| SEC-9 | major · K's end | any member labels her own text as "Claude's attempt" | **Fixed, differently** from the review's table of answers: `study_ask_to_group` attaches an attempt only with the server key (`forbidden`); op `ask`'s share path checks the answer's signature (`verifyTurn`, already in K's `server/study/ask.ts`) and that the question is the turn's own, then calls with the member's token and the key. No new table | SR9a-SR9b, KS1, KS1a, CS8 |
| SEC-10 | minor · V | backing counts "from 3": one's own back and un-back reveals how two others backed | **Fixed.** Counts only after VAR is asked or the dispute decided, from 3 **other** backers; backing closes when VAR is asked; the published row has no backers' total | SR10a-SR10d, V2d, V2f-V2i |
| SEC-11 | minor · M | one's own tap lifts a paragraph over 3; the tap's quote is free text that reaches the reader and catch-up | **Fixed.** The reader cannot tap (`is reader`); the card counts other members' taps; taps and stops store no text | SR11a-SR11c, M5b |
| SEC-12 | minor · M | catch-up's "קראו" is a published read row with its time | **Fixed.** Written the next study day, with the meeting's time | SR12a-SR12b, M12e, M12f |
| SEC-13 | minor · Q's end | one member, with one flag of a kind that "never counts", retires a question for everyone | **Fixed** with SEC-2: retiring is the fix of a hidden question only | SR2f, SR2g |
| SEC-14 | minor · J + storage | any member deletes any wall photo; a post may reuse another's upload; the bucket has no limits | **Fixed.** A post uses one's own upload, on one entry (`bad photo`); only the uploader deletes a wall photo (section F's end, keeping F0's rule); the bucket: 25 MB, JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF | SR14a-SR14d; F28-F28f on F0's file |
| SEC-15 | minor · V, U | VAR and the plaque have no single-flight hold: two taps pay twice | **Fixed.** `study_dispute_judge_begin` and `study_trap_plaque_begin` hold before the op reserves (`busy`) | SR15a-SR15d, V2f-V2i, V5 |
| notes | design text | K5 sends names to Anthropic; race points disclose the bet; bank reservations hold the budget; live totals per event | **Fixed:** threads go as `Q: … / A: …` without names (§12.3.K); the privacy note says race points show the bet (§12.7.5); the reservations are stated (§12.7.3); backing's live total removed and the rest stated (§12.7.2) | — |

### 12.12 The checks, in full

Printed as they ran in §12.8. Where they go in the repo: the shared checks into `supabase/tests/study.sql`, each inside the markers of the package it checks (95: Q's, Z's, C's and K's ends; 96: M; 97: N, V, T; 98: A's merge), after the spec's; the fun, server and review checks as `supabase/tests/fun/`, `server/` and `review/` (each run in a database of its own, as `identity.sql` is, because they create groups). The check IDs in §12.3-§12.6's tables name these lines.

```sql
-- Test helpers (the owner calls them; no member can).
create schema if not exists mtest;
create or replace function mtest.shift(p_quiz uuid, p_secs numeric) returns void language sql as $$
  update public.study_quiz_rounds set opens_at = opens_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision),
                                      closes_at = closes_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision)
   where quiz_id = p_quiz and opens_at is not null and revealed_at is null;
  update public.study_quizzes set opens_at = opens_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision),
                                  closes_at = closes_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision)
   where id = p_quiz;
$$;
create or replace function mtest.key_now(p_quiz uuid) returns int language sql as $$
  select k.answer::int from public.study_quizzes z
    join public.study_quiz_rounds r on r.quiz_id = z.id and r.idx = z.idx
    join public.study_question_keys k on k.question_id = r.question_id where z.id = p_quiz $$;
create or replace function mtest.q_now(p_quiz uuid) returns uuid language sql as $$
  select r.question_id from public.study_quizzes z join public.study_quiz_rounds r on r.quiz_id = z.id and r.idx = z.idx
   where z.id = p_quiz $$;
revoke all on schema mtest from public;
grant usage on schema mtest to authenticated, anon;
```

```sql
do $$
declare c record; n int := 0;
begin
  for c in select * from (values
      ('the same lecture twice a day', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, 0, 1, now(), null::uuid, 'meeting exists'),
      ('parts that are not there', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, 0, 5, now(), null::uuid, 'bad parts'),
      ('parts backwards', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, 1, 0, now(), null::uuid, 'bad parts'),
      ('a lecture of no group', gen_random_uuid(), 0, 0, now(), null::uuid, 'lecture not found'),
      ('a reader who is not a member', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid, 0, 0, now(), 'dddddddd-0000-4000-8000-000000000004'::uuid, 'member not found'),
      ('a month ahead', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'::uuid, 0, 0, now() + interval '30 days', null::uuid, 'bad time')
    ) as t(label, lec, pf, pt, at, reader, want) loop
    begin
      perform public.study_meeting_save(null, null, current_setting('t.gid')::uuid, c.at, c.lec, c.pf, c.pt, '', c.reader);
      raise notice 'M1. FAIL: % was saved', c.label;
    exception when others then if sqlerrm = c.want then n := n + 1; else raise notice 'M1. FAIL: % → %', c.label, sqlerrm; end if; end;
  end loop;
  raise notice 'M1. ok: % of 6 bad meetings refused with their reason', n;
end $$;
```

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  The meeting addendum's lines in study_private.merge_users (section A,
--  edits/apply.py): a device's member folds into the account with rows in
--  every new table, both of them holding a row where only one may stay
--  (A-9's collisions), and nothing is left behind. Same session, last.
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\set ON_ERROR_STOP 1
\pset tuples_only on
reset role;
select id as gid from public.study_groups limit 1 \gset
insert into auth.users (id, raw_user_meta_data) values
 ('3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '{"app":"study","full_name":"שוהם טלפון"}'),
 ('3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', '{"app":"study","full_name":"שוהם חשבון"}');
insert into public.study_members (group_id, user_id, name) values
 (:'gid', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', 'שוהם (טלפון)'), (:'gid', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', 'שוהם (חשבון)');
select id as mid from public.study_meetings where cancelled_at is null and day = study_private.day_of(now()) limit 1 \gset
select id as did from public.study_disputes order by created_at limit 1 \gset
select id as eid from public.study_edits order by created_at limit 1 \gset
-- Both users hold a row in each table where one must stay.
insert into public.study_meeting_taps (meeting_id, user_id, lecture_id, part_idx, anchor)
select :'mid', u, '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 0, 1 from unnest(array['3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b']::uuid[]) u;
insert into public.study_meeting_taps (meeting_id, user_id, lecture_id, part_idx, anchor)
values (:'mid', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 1, 1);
insert into public.study_meeting_presence (meeting_id, user_id, first_at, last_at) values
 (:'mid', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', now() - interval '2 hours', now() - interval '1 hour'),
 (:'mid', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', now() - interval '1 hour', now());
insert into public.study_meeting_guess_answers (meeting_id, question_id, user_id, choice)
select :'mid', '3c2a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004', u, 1 from unnest(array['3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b']::uuid[]) u;
insert into public.study_meeting_catchups (meeting_id, user_id)
select '3c6a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', u from unnest(array['3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b']::uuid[]) u;
insert into public.study_dispute_backs (dispute_id, user_id, side)
select :'did', u, 'a' from unnest(array['3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b']::uuid[]) u;
insert into public.study_updates (user_id, edit_id, lecture_id, part_idx, anchor, reason, reason_at)
select u, :'eid', '3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 1, 1, 'question', now() from unnest(array['3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b']::uuid[]) u;
insert into public.study_member_prefs (user_id, group_id, needs_me)
select u, :'gid', u = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' from unnest(array['3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b']::uuid[]) u;
-- And the columns that only point at a person.
update public.study_meetings set planned_reader = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' where id = :'mid';
insert into public.study_meeting_events (meeting_id, kind, part_idx, anchor, created_by)
values (:'mid', 'continue', 2, 2, '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a');
insert into public.study_slide_flags (lecture_id, slides, note, created_by) values ('3c100000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', array[29], 'pyridine במקום pyrimidine', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a');
update public.study_questions set checked_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' where id = '3c2a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008';
update public.study_cards set checked_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' where id = '3c3a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
update public.study_edit_proposals set proposed_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a'
 where id = (select id from public.study_edit_proposals where state = 'pending' order by created_at limit 1);

select study_private.merge_users('3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b') is null as merged \gset
select 'MG1. merged with a row on both sides in every new table: no collision' as r;
select 'MG2. left behind under the device''s id: ' ||
       (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_taps where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_presence where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_guess_answers where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_catchups where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_dispute_backs where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_updates where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_member_prefs where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_meetings where planned_reader = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_events where created_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_slide_flags where created_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_questions where checked_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_cards where checked_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
     + (select count(*) from public.study_edit_proposals where proposed_by = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a')
       || ' (expect 0)';
select 'MG3. the account kept one of each: taps ' || (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_taps where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ' (the shared paragraph once, and the device''s other one), presence from '
       || (select (now() - first_at) > interval '90 minutes' from public.study_meeting_presence where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ' (the earlier start), guesses ' || (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_guess_answers where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ', catch-ups ' || (select count(*) from public.study_meeting_catchups where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ', backing ' || (select count(*) from public.study_dispute_backs where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ', updates ' || (select count(*) from public.study_updates where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ', prefs ' || (select count(*) from public.study_member_prefs where user_id = '3c000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b')
       || ' (expect 2, true, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)';
select 'MG4. ' || coalesce('FAIL: not merged: ' || string_agg(t || '.' || col, ', '), 'ok: every user column of the addendum''s tables is merged')
from (
  select format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname) as t, a.attname as col
  from pg_constraint k
  join pg_class c on c.oid = k.conrelid
  join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
  join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = k.conrelid and a.attnum = any (k.conkey)
  where k.contype = 'f' and k.confrelid = 'auth.users'::regclass
    and n.nspname = 'public'
    and c.relname in ('study_meetings', 'study_meeting_taps', 'study_meeting_events', 'study_meeting_presence', 'study_meeting_guess_answers',
                      'study_meeting_catchups', 'study_disputes', 'study_dispute_backs', 'study_slide_flags', 'study_updates', 'study_member_prefs',
                      'study_edit_proposals', 'study_edits', 'study_questions', 'study_cards')
    and position(format('update %I.%I set %I = dst', n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname)
                 in (select p.prosrc from pg_proc p join pg_namespace pn on pn.oid = p.pronamespace
                      where pn.nspname = 'study_private' and p.proname = 'merge_users')) = 0
) missing;
select 'MG5. what anon may call is still only the allow-list: ' || coalesce('FAIL: ' || string_agg(p.proname, ', ' order by p.proname), 'ok')
  from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname like 'study\_%' and has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'execute')
   and p.proname not in ('study_claim', 'study_progress', 'study_finish', 'study_outline_done', 'study_writing_input',
                         'study_reserve', 'study_settle', 'study_spent', 'study_feature_on', 'study_features', 'study_schema', 'study_email_allowed',
                         'study_is_member', 'study_lecture_group', 'study_is_member_path',
                         'study_bank_take', 'study_bank_input', 'study_bank_report', 'study_bank_save', 'study_bank_finish');
select 'MG6. the registry with the addendum: ' || public.study_schema()::text
       || ' (expect A 1, B 1, C 2, E 1, F 1, G 1, H 1, J 1, K 2, M 1, N 1, P 2, Q 2, T 1, U 1, V 1, W 1, Z 2)';
```

#### 12.12.2 The fun checks (U, J, H, the merge; own database)

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  addendum "fun" checks · fixtures (a database of their own: they create the
--  group). Load order: stubs.sql, stubs-additions.sql, board-schema.sql,
--  study-schema.sql, every spec section (with the A and Z patches),
--  00-standins.sql, sections U, J, H, all twice; then 10-fixtures.sql,
--  20-pulse-test.sql, 30-wall-test.sql, 40-boss-test.sql, 50-later-test.sql,
--  60-merge-test.sql in one psql session. Each line reads "<label>. ok: …
--  (expect …)" or "<label>. FAIL: …"; time is simulated by counting for a
--  fixed instant (pulse_night's p_now) and by moving quiz rounds into the
--  past as the table owner, never by sleeping.
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\set ON_ERROR_STOP 1
\pset tuples_only on
\o /dev/null
reset role;
create schema if not exists funtest;
create or replace function funtest.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text) returns text language sql as $$
  select p_label || '. ' || case when p_got is not distinct from p_want then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end
         || ': ' || coalesce(p_got, 'null') || ' (expect ' || coalesce(p_want, 'null') || ')'
$$;
grant usage on schema funtest to anon, authenticated;
grant execute on function funtest.expect(text, text, text) to anon, authenticated;
```

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  addendum "fun" checks · SECTION U: the nightly counts, the pulse, traps, the museum
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\set ON_ERROR_STOP 1
\pset tuples_only on
reset role;

-- ═════════ 0. The switch, the schedule, the interface ═════════
select funtest.expect('U0', (select string_agg(table_name || '.' || column_name, ', ' order by table_name)
                               from information_schema.columns
                              where table_schema = 'public' and ((table_name = 'study_answers' and column_name = 'confidence')
                                 or (table_name in ('study_questions', 'study_cards') and column_name = 'anchor'))),
       'study_answers.confidence, study_cards.anchor, study_questions.anchor');
select funtest.expect('U0a', study_private.pulse_night(:'gid')::text || ' groups counted, switch ' || study_private.feature_on('pulse'),
       '0 groups counted, switch false');
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2';
select funtest.expect('U0b', coalesce(public.study_pulse_ready(:'gid')::text, 'null') || ' · rows ' || (select count(*) from public.study_pulse(:'gid')),
       'null · rows 0');
reset role;
select funtest.expect('U0c', (select schedule from cron.job where jobname = 'study-pulse-night'), '17 2 * * *');
update study_private.features set enabled = true, changed_at = now() where name = 'pulse';

-- ═════════ 1. Three nights: 6 days ago, yesterday, today ═════════
select funtest.expect('U1', study_private.pulse_night(:'gid', :'c0'::timestamptz - interval '6 days' + interval '1 hour')::text, '1');
select funtest.expect('U1a', (select bucket || ' ' || topic from public.study_pulse_topics where topic_key = 'luminal'), 'hot Luminal');
select funtest.expect('U1b', study_private.pulse_night(:'gid', :'c0'::timestamptz - interval '1 day' + interval '1 hour')::text, '1');
select funtest.expect('U1c', (select string_agg(right(question_id::text, 1) || '/' || option || '=' || state, ', ' order by question_id) from public.study_traps),
       '1/2=pending, 5/0=pending, 6/1=open');
-- Found last night, numbered, and still closed: an exhibit opens only the next study day.
select funtest.expect('U1d', (select 'exhibit #' || exhibit_no || ' ' || state || ', opens at the next study day: ' || (exhibit_at = :'c0'::timestamptz and opens_at = :'c0'::timestamptz)
                                from public.study_traps where question_id = 'f1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005'),
       'exhibit #1 pending, opens at the next study day: true');
select funtest.expect('U1e', study_private.pulse_night(:'gid', :'c0'::timestamptz + interval '1 hour')::text, '1');
select funtest.expect('U1f', study_private.pulse_night(:'gid', :'c0'::timestamptz + interval '3 hours')::text, '0');
select funtest.expect('U1g', (select counted::text from study_private.pulse_runs where group_id = :'gid'),
       '{"cards": 1, "spots": 4, "topics": 5, "questions": 4, "traps_open": 3}');
```

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  addendum "fun" checks · SECTION H: the boss battle (on section Z's engine)
--  The pulse of 20-pulse-test.sql: hot Miltefosine (4 of 4 struggle),
--  Primaquine and Quinine (4 of 5); open traps on q1 (option 2) and q5
--  (option 0, the museum's exhibit).
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
\set ON_ERROR_STOP 1
\pset tuples_only on
reset role;
-- Moves the open round (and the quiz row's copy of its times) p_secs into the past (as Z's checks do).
create or replace function pg_temp.shift(p_quiz uuid, p_secs numeric) returns void language sql as $$
  update public.study_quiz_rounds set opens_at = opens_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision),
                                      closes_at = closes_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision)
   where quiz_id = p_quiz and opens_at is not null and revealed_at is null;
  update public.study_quizzes set opens_at = opens_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision),
                                  closes_at = closes_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision)
   where id = p_quiz;
$$;
-- A member's call, as that member (the claim the stub's auth.uid() reads).
create or replace function pg_temp.next(p_quiz uuid, p_user text, p_from int) returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000' || p_user, true);
  perform public.study_quiz_next(p_quiz, p_from);
  perform pg_temp.shift(p_quiz, 4);   -- the 3-second countdown is over
end $$;
-- "a1:2,a2:x": each player's choice for the round on screen (x = לא יודעים).
create or replace function pg_temp.play(p_quiz uuid, p_idx int, p_moves text) returns void language plpgsql as $$
declare m text;
begin
  foreach m in array string_to_array(p_moves, ',') loop
    perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000' || split_part(m, ':', 1), true);
    perform public.study_quiz_answer(p_quiz, p_idx, nullif(split_part(m, ':', 2), 'x')::int);
  end loop;
end $$;
create or replace function pg_temp.hud(p_quiz uuid) returns text language sql as $$
  select 'team ' || (b ->> 'team_hp') || ' · boss ' || (b ->> 'boss_hp') || ' · heads '
         || (select string_agg((h ->> 'name') || '=' || (h ->> 'hp') || case when (h ->> 'down')::boolean then '✓' else '' end
                               || case when (h ->> 'relapses')::int > 0 then '(r' || (h ->> 'relapses') || ')' else '' end, ' ')
               from jsonb_array_elements(b -> 'heads') h)
    from public.study_quiz__boss_state(p_quiz) b $$;

set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1';
-- ═════════ 1. Opening a battle ═════════
reset role;
update study_private.features set enabled = false where name = 'pulse';
set role authenticated;
do $$ begin perform public.study_boss_create(current_setting('t.gid')::uuid, array['f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001']::uuid[]);
  raise notice 'H1. FAIL: a battle while the pulse is off';
exception when others then raise notice 'H1. %: the boss is built from the counts (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'off' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
reset role;
update study_private.features set enabled = true where name = 'pulse';
set role authenticated;
do $$ begin perform public.study_boss_create(current_setting('t.gid')::uuid, array['f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002']::uuid[]);
  raise notice 'H1a. FAIL: a battle with no hot topic';
exception when others then raise notice 'H1a. %: at least two heads (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'no heads' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
select funtest.expect('H1b', (select (b -> 'heads')::text || ' · revenge ' || coalesce(b ->> 'revenge', 'none') from public.study_boss_open(:'gid') b),
       '["Miltefosine", "Primaquine", "Quinine"] · revenge none');
-- review SEC-8: the heads are hot topics; Noa's laptop (never saved) is not counted, so it reads none
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b2';

set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1';
select set_config('t.bq', public.study_boss_create(:'gid', array['f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001']::uuid[], 45)::text, false) is not null as bq \gset

select funtest.expect('H1d', (select string_agg((h ->> 'name') || ' ' || (h ->> 'max') || ' HP, ' || jsonb_array_length(h -> 'qs') || 'q'
                                                || coalesce(', trap q' || right(h ->> 'trap_q', 1) || '/' || (h ->> 'trap_opt'), ''), ' · ' order by o)
                                from public.study_boss_battles b, jsonb_array_elements(b.heads) with ordinality as x(h, o)

-- ═════════ 2. The battle: hits, the team's losses, relapses, the trap ═════════

set role authenticated;

                                     || ' · trap ' || (s -> 'boss' ->> 'trap') || ' · counts ' || (s -> 'round' -> 'counts')::text

select set_config('t.bq2', public.study_boss_create(:'gid', array['f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001']::uuid[], 45)::text, false) is not null as bq2 \gset
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2';

set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a3';
select public.study_quiz_join(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid) is null as j \gset
reset role;
select pg_temp.next(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 'a1', -1);
select pg_temp.play(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 0, 'a1:0,a2:0');
select pg_temp.shift(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 60);
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a3';
select public.study_quiz_reveal(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 0) is null as rv \gset
reset role;
select funtest.expect('H6', pg_temp.hud(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid) || ' · few ' || (select b.rounds -> 0 ->> 'few' from public.study_boss_battles b where b.quiz_id = current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid),
       'team 100 · boss 100 · heads Miltefosine=34 Primaquine=33 Quinine=33 · few true');
select pg_temp.next(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 'a1', 0);
select pg_temp.play(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 1, 'a1:2,a2:2,a3:2');
select pg_temp.next(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 'a1', 1);
select pg_temp.play(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 2, 'a1:1,a2:1,a3:1');
select pg_temp.next(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 'a1', 2);
select pg_temp.play(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 3, 'a1:1,a2:1,a3:1');
select funtest.expect('H6a', (select outcome || ' · team ' || team_hp || ' · ' || (select string_agg(m ->> 't', ',' order by o) from jsonb_array_elements(log) with ordinality as x(m, o))
                                from public.study_boss_battles where quiz_id = current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid),
       'lost · team 0 · trap,relapse,fall');
select funtest.expect('H6b', (select count(*)::text from public.study_quiz_rounds where quiz_id = current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid and question_id is not null and opens_at is null),
       '0');
select pg_temp.next(current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid, 'a1', 3);
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1';
select set_config('t.lost', (select id::text from public.study_boss_battles where quiz_id = current_setting('t.bq2')::uuid), false) is not null as l \gset
select funtest.expect('H7', (select (b -> 'revenge' ->> 'open') || ' · ' || (b -> 'revenge' -> 'heads')::text from public.study_boss_open(:'gid') b),
       'false · ["Miltefosine", "Primaquine", "Quinine"]');
do $$ begin perform public.study_boss_create(current_setting('t.gid')::uuid, null, 45, current_setting('t.lost')::uuid);
  raise notice 'H7a. FAIL: a revenge round the same study day';
exception when others then raise notice 'H7a. %: the next study day (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'revenge not yet' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
reset role;
update public.study_boss_battles set ended_at = ended_at - interval '1 day' where id = current_setting('t.lost')::uuid;   -- a day passes
set role authenticated;
select set_config('t.bq3', public.study_boss_create(:'gid', null, 45, current_setting('t.lost')::uuid)::text, false) is not null as bq3 \gset
reset role;
select funtest.expect('H7b', (select (revenge_of = current_setting('t.lost')::uuid)::text || ' · ' || pg_temp.hud(quiz_id) from public.study_boss_battles where quiz_id = current_setting('t.bq3')::uuid),
       'true · team 100 · boss 100 · heads Miltefosine=34 Primaquine=33 Quinine=33');
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1';
select public.study_quiz_end(current_setting('t.bq3')::uuid) is null as e \gset
reset role;
```

```sql
       'every user column of U, J, H is merged')
from (
  select format('%I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname) as t, a.attname as col
    from pg_constraint k join pg_class c on c.oid = k.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
    join pg_attribute a on a.attrelid = k.conrelid and a.attnum = any (k.conkey)
   where k.contype = 'f' and k.confrelid = 'auth.users'::regclass and n.nspname = 'public'

     and position(format('update %I.%I set %I = dst', n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname)
                  in (select p.prosrc from pg_proc p join pg_namespace pn on pn.oid = p.pronamespace
                       where pn.nspname = 'study_private' and p.proname = 'merge_users')) = 0) missing;

                              where k.contype = 'f' and k.confrelid = 'auth.users'::regclass and n.nspname = 'public'
                                and (c.relname like 'study\_pulse%' or c.relname like 'study\_aid%' or c.relname in ('study_traps', 'study_boss_battles', 'study_loot'))),
       '9');
```

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  The server addendum's checks · fixtures of their own (a database of
--  their own, as the spec's identity.sql: they create a group). Six members
--  and a stranger, two lectures with written parts, placed questions with
--  keys, cards, and the server switched on (pg_net's stand-in records every
--  kick in net.calls). Time is simulated by moving rows into the past as the
--  owner, never by sleeping. Throwaway local Postgres only.

\pset tuples_only on

 ('a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004', '{"app":"study","full_name":"איתי"}', true),
```

```sql
-- QS11-QS14: the worker path. A part is planned and saved by the worker (the
-- key, no member); a diagram that exists is kept, an unknown one dropped;
-- whens and tags are stored; a held part is busy for a member's tap.
reset role;
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select 'QS11. anon may call study_save_question: ' || has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.study_save_question(uuid, uuid, jsonb, text)', 'execute')
       || ', study_question_round: ' || has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.study_question_round(uuid, text)', 'execute')
       || ' (expect false, false: the worker reaches them only through section B)';
reset role;
create schema if not exists stest;
-- As the worker would (inside section B's definer functions): no member token, the key.
create or replace function stest.worker_round(p_lecture uuid, p_key text) returns int language plpgsql security definer as $$
declare r int; b record;
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true);
  select x.round into r from public.study_question_round(p_lecture, p_key) x;
  for b in select id from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = p_lecture and round = r loop
    perform public.study_question_claim(b.id, p_key);
  end loop;
  return r;
end $$;
select stest.worker_round(:'l1', :'key') as wr \gset
select 'QS11b. the worker planned round ' || :'wr' || ' with ' || count(*) || ' parts writing (expect 1, 3)'
  from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l1' and status = 'writing';
do $$ begin perform stest.worker_round(current_setting('t.l1')::uuid, 'not-the-key-0123456789abcdef0123'); raise notice 'QS11c. FAIL: planned without the key';
exception when others then raise notice 'QS11c. %: no key, no plan (%)', case when sqlerrm in ('not signed in', 'forbidden') then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
select id as qb from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l1' and part_idx = 0 \gset
create or replace function stest.worker_save(p_batch uuid, p_q jsonb, p_key text) returns uuid language plpgsql security definer as $$
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true);
  return public.study_save_question(p_batch, null, p_q, p_key);
end $$;
select stest.worker_save(:'qb', '{"kind":"case","difficulty":2,"vignette":"מטייל חזר מתאילנד.","question":"מה לפני השחרור?",
  "options":["Artesunate","G6PD ו-Primaquine","Mefloquine","Doxycycline","לשחרר"],"answer":1,
  "explanations":["א [ש'' 3]","ב [ש'' 5]","ג [ש'' 7]","ד [ש'' 7]","ה [ש'' 3]"],
  "whens":["מתי כן: מלריה קשה","","מתי כן: שלב הדם","מתי כן: מניעה","מתי לא: אף פעם"],
  "option_tags":["Artesunate","Primaquine","Mefloquine","Doxycycline",""],
  "takeaway":"לפני Primaquine: G6PD [ש'' 7]","slides":[5,7],"topic":"Primaquine","aspect":"contra","para":2,"quote":"ה-Hypnozoite ישן",
  "teaser":"vivax אחרי תאילנד","figure":"fig:5-1","model":"claude-opus-5-5"}'::jsonb, :'key') as q8 \gset
select 'QS12. saved by the worker: figure ' || q.figure || ', tags ' || cardinality(q.option_tags) || ', anchor ' || q.anchor
       || ', whens ' || cardinality(k.whens) || ', created_by ' || coalesce(q.created_by::text, 'none') || ' (expect fig:5-1, 5, 2, 5, none)'
  from public.study_questions q join public.study_question_keys k on k.question_id = q.id where q.id = :'q8';
select stest.worker_save(:'qb', '{"kind":"mcq","question":"מה עוד?","options":["א","ב","ג","ד","ה"],"answer":0,
  "explanations":["1","2","3","4","5"],"slides":[3],"topic":"X","aspect":"other","figure":"fig:9-9"}'::jsonb, :'key') as q9 \gset
select 'QS12b. an unknown picture is dropped, the question kept: ' || coalesce(nullif(figure, ''), '(none)') || ' (expect (none))'
  from public.study_questions where id = :'q9';
do $$ begin perform stest.worker_save(current_setting('t.qb', true)::uuid, '{}'::jsonb, current_setting('t.key')); raise notice 'QS12c. skipped';
exception when others then raise notice 'QS12c. ok: a malformed item is refused (%)', sqlerrm; end $$;
do $$ begin perform stest.worker_save((select id from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = current_setting('t.l1')::uuid and part_idx = 1),
  '{"kind":"mcq","question":"מה?","options":["א","ב","ג","ד","ה"],"answer":0,"explanations":["1","2","3","4","5"],"whens":["x"],"slides":[15]}'::jsonb,
  current_setting('t.key')); raise notice 'QS12d. FAIL: whens of the wrong length';
exception when others then raise notice 'QS12d. %: whens must match the options (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'whens do not match options' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
update public.study_question_batches set hold_until = now() + interval '3 hours', status = 'pending' where lecture_id = :'l1' and part_idx = 2;
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
do $$ begin perform public.study_question_claim((select id from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = current_setting('t.l1')::uuid and part_idx = 2),
  current_setting('t.key')); raise notice 'QS13. FAIL: a member took a part the Batch API holds';
exception when others then raise notice 'QS13. %: a held part is busy for a tap (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'busy' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;

  from public.study_question_claim((select id from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l1' and part_idx = 2), :'key');
reset role;
create or replace function stest.worker_finish(p_batch uuid, p_key text) returns void language plpgsql security definer as $$
begin
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true);
  perform public.study_question_finish(p_batch, 'ready', 1, 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.02, null, p_key, 2);
end $$;

       || ' (expect ready, 1, 2, none)' from public.study_question_batches where id = :'qb';
select 'QS-reg. Q = ' || (public.study_schema() ->> 'Q') || ' (expect 2)';
```

```sql
  jsonb_build_object('state', 1, 'step', 0, 'stability', 2.3, 'difficulty', 5.1, 'due', now() + interval '10 minutes', 'lapses', 0))
  || ', again: ' || public.study_my_card_review('a6000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', :'mc', 3, now(), 4000, 0,
  jsonb_build_object('state', 1, 'step', 0, 'stability', 2.3, 'difficulty', 5.1, 'due', now() + interval '10 minutes', 'lapses', 0))
  || ' (expect ok, dup)';
do $$ begin perform public.study_my_card_review('a6000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', (select id from public.study_my_cards where question_id = 'a4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006'),
  3, now(), 1000, 0, jsonb_build_object('state', 2, 'step', 0, 'stability', 5, 'difficulty', 5, 'due', now() + interval '1 day', 'lapses', 0));
  raise notice 'CS7b. FAIL: a stale review (reps 0 after one answer)';
exception when others then raise notice 'CS7b. %: another device''s answer in between (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'stale' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
do $$ begin perform public.study_my_card_review('a6000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', (select id from public.study_my_cards where question_id = 'a4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006'),
  1, now(), 1000, 1, jsonb_build_object('state', 3, 'step', 0, 'stability', 1, 'difficulty', 6, 'due', now() + interval '5 minutes', 'lapses', 1));
  raise notice 'CS7c. FAIL: a lapse counted on a learning card';
exception when others then raise notice 'CS7c. %: a lapse is שוב on a card in review only (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'bad state' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
select public.study_my_card_undo('a6000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001');
select 'CS7d. undone: state ' || state || ', reps ' || reps || ' (expect 0, 0)' from public.study_my_cards where id = :'mc';
select public.study_my_card_set(:'mc', 'delete');
select 'CS7e. deleted: ' || (deleted_at is not null) || ' (expect true)' from public.study_my_cards where id = :'mc';
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
do $$ begin perform public.study_my_card_set((select id from public.study_my_cards where question_id = 'a4000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006'
  and user_id = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'), 'restore'); raise notice 'CS7f. FAIL: Noa restored Maya''s card';
exception when others then raise notice 'CS7f. %: only the owner (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'card not found' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;

-- CS8: K4. The answer to her own question becomes her card; not someone else's question.
select public.study_ask_to_group(:'l1', 0, 2, 'ה-Hypnozoite ישן', 'למה דווקא Primaquine?', 'Primaquine מגיעה ל-hypnozoites [ש'' 5]', :'key') as kq \gset
select 'CS8. card from her answered question: ' || (public.study_my_card_add(:'l1', 'answer', 0, 2, 'Primaquine: למה דווקא היא?',
  'רק היא מגיעה ל-hypnozoites', array[5], :'kq') is not null) || ' (expect true)';
do $$ begin perform public.study_my_card_add(current_setting('t.l1')::uuid, 'answer', 0, 2, 'שוב?', 'כן', '{}',
  (select id from public.study_comments where body = 'למה דווקא Primaquine?')); raise notice 'CS8b. FAIL: a second card for one thread';
exception when others then raise notice 'CS8b. %: one card per thread (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'already' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005';
do $$ begin perform public.study_my_card_add(current_setting('t.l1')::uuid, 'answer', 0, 2, 'של נועה?', 'לא', '{}',
  (select id from public.study_comments where body = 'למה דווקא Primaquine?')); raise notice 'CS8c. FAIL: a card from someone else''s question';
exception when others then raise notice 'CS8c. %: only from one''s own question (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'not yours' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
select 'CS8d. a wrong cell of a blank table: ' || (public.study_my_card_add(:'l1', 'table', 0, null, 'Atovaquone-proguanil על hypnozoite?',
  'לא: רק כבד ראשוני ודם [ש'' 23]', array[23]) is not null) || ' (expect true)';

-- CS9: C6, one review home, written by the owner through RLS.
insert into public.study_card_settings (home) values ('anki');
select 'CS9. home: ' || home || ' (expect anki)' from public.study_card_settings where user_id = auth.uid();
do $$ begin insert into public.study_card_settings (home) values ('both'); raise notice 'CS9b. FAIL: a third home';
exception when others then raise notice 'CS9b. ok: a home is the app or Anki (%)', sqlerrm; end $$;

-- CS10: privacy. The new private tables: RLS on, never published, no anon grant.
reset role;
select 'CS10. private tables published: ' || count(*) || ' (expect 0)' from pg_publication_tables
 where pubname = 'supabase_realtime' and tablename in ('study_card_adoptions', 'study_my_cards', 'study_my_card_reviews');
select 'CS10b. RLS on: ' || count(*) filter (where relrowsecurity) || ' of ' || count(*) || ', anon may read: '
       || count(*) filter (where has_table_privilege('anon', oid, 'select')) || ' (expect 3 of 3, 0)'
  from pg_class where relname in ('study_card_adoptions', 'study_my_cards', 'study_my_card_reviews') and relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace;
select 'CS-reg. C = ' || (public.study_schema() ->> 'C') || ' (expect 2)';
```

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  Section B · BS: the bank written ahead. The switch, the upload's
--  question, the automatic job, planning and holding the parts, the worker's
--  steps (submit, poll, stage for the blind solver, save, finish), the
--  deadline and the fall-back to normal writing, cancelling, privacy.
--  The worker is anon with the key and no member token, as on Vercel.
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
reset role;
-- Three more lectures with written parts and text on their slides.
insert into public.study_lectures (id, group_id, course, title, source_kind, slides, status, created_by)
select ('a3000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000' || x)::uuid, 'a2000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', 'פתוגן מאכסן', 'הרצאה ' || x, 'pptx',
       (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n', n, 'title', 'שקף ' || n, 'lines', jsonb_build_array(repeat('Metronidazole ואלכוהול ', 6)),
                                            'tables', '[]'::jsonb, 'notes', '', 'figures', '[]'::jsonb) order by n) from generate_series(1, 20) n),
       'writing', 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'
  from generate_series(3, 5) x;
insert into public.study_sections (lecture_id, idx, title, slide_from, slide_to, status, markdown)
select ('a3000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000' || x)::uuid, p, 'חלק ' || p, 1 + 10 * p, 10 + 10 * p, 'ready', '## חלק ' || p || E'\n\nפסקה. [ש'' ' || (1 + 10 * p) || ']'
  from generate_series(3, 5) x, generate_series(0, 1) p;
\set l3 'a3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'
\set l4 'a3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004'
\set l5 'a3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005'
select set_config('t.l3', :'l3', false) is not null as x \gset
create or replace function stest.kicks(p_job uuid) returns int language sql as $$
  select count(*)::int from net.calls c where c.body ->> 'bank' = p_job::text $$;

-- BS1-BS2: the switch is off. The upload asks; a ready summary starts nothing.
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
select 'BS1. mode with the switch off: ' || public.study_bank_mode(:'g') || ' (expect server: ask at upload, the server writes on "כן")';
reset role;
update public.study_lectures set status = 'ready' where id = :'l3';
select 'BS1b. a ready summary with the switch off: ' || count(*) || ' job(s) (expect 0)' from study_private.bank_jobs where lecture_id = :'l3';
update public.study_lectures set status = 'writing' where id = :'l3';
-- "כן, להכין" at upload: a job that waits for the summary, at full price.
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
select 'BS2. asked at upload: ' || public.study_bank_request(:'l2') || ' (expect waiting)';
select 'BS2b. asked again: ' || public.study_bank_request(:'l2') || ' (expect waiting: one job per lecture)';
select 'BS2c. as a member sees it: ' || (public.study_bank_state(:'l2') ->> 'state') || ', mode ' || (public.study_bank_state(:'l2') ->> 'mode')
       || ', no batch id: ' || (not (public.study_bank_state(:'l2') ? 'msg_batch'))::text || ' (expect waiting, now, true)';
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009';
do $$ begin perform public.study_bank_state(current_setting('t.l2')::uuid); raise notice 'BS2d. FAIL: a stranger read a job';
exception when others then raise notice 'BS2d. %: members only (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'lecture not found' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
reset role;
select id as j2 from study_private.bank_jobs where lecture_id = :'l2' \gset
update public.study_lectures set status = 'ready' where id = :'l2';
select 'BS3. the summary is ready: ' || state || ', kicked ' || stest.kicks(:'j2') || ' (expect new, 1)' from study_private.bank_jobs where id = :'j2';

-- BS4: the worker. Without the key, or with a member's token, nothing.
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
do $$ begin perform public.study_bank_take(gen_random_uuid(), 'not-the-key'); raise notice 'BS4. FAIL';
exception when others then raise notice 'BS4. %: the worker needs the key (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'forbidden' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
reset role;
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
do $$ begin perform public.study_bank_take(gen_random_uuid(), current_setting('t.key')); raise notice 'BS4b. FAIL: a member called the worker''s function';
exception when others then raise notice 'BS4b. ok: members cannot call it, even with the key (%)', sqlerrm; end $$;
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
-- Mode now (asked at upload): planned, written normally at once, part by part.
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j2', :'key')) as t \gset
select 'BS5. first step: ' || (:'t'::jsonb ->> 'step') || ', row ' || (:'t'::jsonb -> 'row' ->> 'kind') || ' part ' || (:'t'::jsonb -> 'row' ->> 'part_idx')
       || ', rows ' || jsonb_array_length(:'t'::jsonb -> 'rows') || ' (expect write, q part 0, 4: two question parts, two card parts)';
reset role;
select 'BS5b. the parts: ' || string_agg(via || ':' || status || ':' || coalesce(hold_until::text, 'no hold'), ' ' order by part_idx)
       || ' (expect server:writing:no hold ×2)' from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l2';
select 'BS5c. card parts: ' || string_agg(via || ':' || status || ':' || wanted, ' ' order by part_idx) || ' (expect server:writing:5 ×2)'
  from public.study_card_batches where lecture_id = :'l2';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select 'BS5d. while the lease is held: ' || coalesce(public.study_bank_take(:'j2', :'key')::text, 'nothing') || ' (expect nothing)';
reset role;
select id as q2a from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l2' and part_idx = 0 \gset
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select public.study_bank_save(:'j2', (:'t'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'q', :'q2a', '{"kind":"mcq","question":"מה Miltefosine מחייבת?",
  "options":["אמצעי מניעה","ECG","G6PD","תפקודי כבד","כלום"],"answer":0,"explanations":["כן [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]"],
  "whens":["","מתי כן: Pentostam","מתי כן: Primaquine","",""],"takeaway":"Miltefosine טרטוגנית [ש'' 2]","slides":[2],"topic":"Miltefosine","aspect":"contra","para":1}'::jsonb, :'key') is not null as bs6;
select public.study_bank_finish(:'j2', (:'t'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'q', :'q2a', 'ready', 0, 1, 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.03, null, :'key');
select 'BS6. step done: ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j2', (:'t'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'step_done', '{}'::jsonb, :'key') || ' (expect fallback)';
reset role;
select 'BS6b. the part: ' || status || ', made ' || made || ', solver rejected ' || solver_rejected || ' (expect ready, 1, 1)'
  from public.study_question_batches where id = :'q2a';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select 'BS6c. next step: ' || (public.study_bank_take(:'j2', :'key') -> 'row' ->> 'part_idx') || ' (expect 1: the next question part)';
reset role;
-- The rest fails here (no model in a test): taps can write it.
update study_private.bank_jobs set lease_until = now() - interval '1 second' where id = :'j2';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j2', :'key')) as t2 \gset
select 'BS7. given up: ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j2', (:'t2'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'failed', '{"error":"api_500"}'::jsonb, :'key') || ' (expect failed)';
select 'BS7b. after failing: ' || coalesce(public.study_bank_take(:'j2', :'key')::text, 'nothing') || ' (expect nothing)';

-- BS8-BS12: the switch on. A ready summary starts a batch job by itself; a
-- meeting on the lecture in five hours sets the deadline 90 minutes before.
reset role;
update study_private.features set enabled = true where name = 'bank';
insert into public.study_meetings (group_id, day, starts_at, lecture_id, part_from, part_to)
values (:'g', (now() + interval '5 hours')::date, now() + interval '5 hours', :'l3', 0, 1);
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
select 'BS8. mode with the switch on: ' || public.study_bank_mode(:'g') || ' (expect batch)';
reset role;
update public.study_lectures set status = 'ready' where id = :'l3';
select id as j3 from study_private.bank_jobs where lecture_id = :'l3' \gset
select 'BS8b. automatic: ' || mode || ', ' || state || ', kicked ' || stest.kicks(:'j3') || ' (expect batch, new, 1)' from study_private.bank_jobs where id = :'j3';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j3', :'key')) as t3 \gset
select 'BS9. first step: ' || (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'step') || ', deadline ' ||
       round(extract(epoch from ((:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'deadline')::timestamptz - now())) / 60) || ' min away (expect submit, 210)';
reset role;
select 'BS9b. held: ' || string_agg(via || ':' || status || ':' || round(extract(epoch from (hold_until - now())) / 60), ' ' order by part_idx)
       || ' (expect batch:writing:220 ×2)' from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l3';
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004';
select 'BS9c. a tap meanwhile gets the open round: fresh ' || fresh || ' (expect false)' from public.study_question_round(:'l3');
do $$ begin perform public.study_question_claim((select id from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = current_setting('t.l3', true)::uuid and part_idx = 0),
  current_setting('t.key')); raise notice 'BS9d. FAIL: a tap took a held part';
exception when others then raise notice 'BS9d. %: the part is busy while the batch holds it (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'busy' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;
select 'BS9e. what members see: ' || (public.study_bank_state(:'l3') ->> 'state') || ' (expect starting)';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select 'BS10. the worker''s input: ' || jsonb_array_length(i -> 'parts') || ' parts, ' || jsonb_array_length(i -> 'rows') || ' rows, slides '
       || jsonb_array_length(i -> 'lecture' -> 'slides') || ' (expect 2, 4, 20)'
  from (select public.study_bank_input(:'j3', :'key') as i) x;
-- The worker reserves at batch prices (no member) and submits the write batch.
select public.study_reserve(:'g', :'l3', 'bank', :'j3', 0.62, 33, 0.8, null, null, null, :'key') as res \gset
select 'BS10b. submitted: ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'submitted',
  jsonb_build_object('stage', 'write', 'msg_batch', 'msgbatch_01TestWrite', 'reservation', :'res'), :'key') || ' (expect writing)';
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004';
select 'BS10c. members see: ' || (public.study_bank_state(:'l3') ->> 'state') || ', ready by ' ||
       round(extract(epoch from ((public.study_bank_state(:'l3') ->> 'ready_by')::timestamptz - now())) / 60) || ' min (expect batch, 210)';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j3', :'key')) as t3 \gset
select 'BS11. next: ' || (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'step') || ' (expect poll)';
select 'BS11b. still in progress: ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'polled', '{}'::jsonb, :'key') || ' (expect writing)';
-- Ended: the cards are saved; the questions are staged for the blind solver; part 1's request expired.
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j3', :'key')) as t3 \gset
reset role;
select id as c3a from public.study_card_batches where lecture_id = :'l3' and part_idx = 0 \gset
select id as c3b from public.study_card_batches where lecture_id = :'l3' and part_idx = 1 \gset
select id as q3a from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l3' and part_idx = 0 \gset
select id as q3b from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l3' and part_idx = 1 \gset
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select public.study_bank_save(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'c', b, '{"kind":"qa","front":"Metronidazole: מה אסור לשתות?","back":"אלכוהול",
  "slides":[2],"topic":"Metronidazole","aspect":"interactions","para":1}'::jsonb, :'key') is not null as bs12
  from unnest(array[:'c3a'::uuid]) b;
select public.study_bank_save(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'c', :'c3b', '{"kind":"cloze","front":"Metronidazole עם {{אלכוהול}} גורמת לתגובה דמוית Disulfiram.",
  "back":"","slides":[12],"topic":"Metronidazole","aspect":"interactions"}'::jsonb, :'key') is not null as bs12b;
select public.study_bank_finish(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'c', b, 'ready', 0, 0, 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.02, null, :'key')
  from unnest(array[:'c3a'::uuid, :'c3b'::uuid]) b;
select public.study_bank_report(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'stage', jsonb_build_object('batch', :'q3a', 'items', jsonb_build_array(
  '{"kind":"mcq","question":"עם מה אסור Metronidazole?","options":["אלכוהול","חלב","מים","קפה","מיץ"],"answer":0,
    "explanations":["כן [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]","לא [ש'' 2]"],"slides":[2],"topic":"Metronidazole","aspect":"interactions"}'::jsonb,
  '{"kind":"mcq","question":"מה עוד?","options":["א","ב","ג","ד","ה"],"answer":3,
    "explanations":["1","2","3","4","5"],"slides":[3],"topic":"X","aspect":"other"}'::jsonb)), :'key') as bs12c;
reset role;
select 'BS12. staged for the solver: ' || count(*) || ', cards ready: ' ||
       (select count(*) from public.study_card_batches where lecture_id = :'l3' and status = 'ready') || ' (expect 2, 2)'
  from study_private.bank_items where job_id = :'j3';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select 'BS12b. the solver''s batch: ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'submitted',
  jsonb_build_object('stage', 'solve', 'msg_batch', 'msgbatch_01TestSolve'), :'key') || ' (expect solving)';
-- The solver agreed with the first key, not with the second: one saved, one rejected.
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j3', :'key')) as t3 \gset
reset role;
select item as passed from study_private.bank_items where job_id = :'j3' and n = 0 \gset
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select public.study_bank_save(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'q', :'q3a', :'passed'::jsonb, :'key') is not null as bs13;
select public.study_bank_finish(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'q', :'q3a', 'ready', 0, 1, 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.01, null, :'key');
select 'BS13. stage ended: ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'ended', '{}'::jsonb, :'key')
       || ' (expect fallback: part 1''s questions never came back)';
select public.study_settle(:'res'::bigint, 'claude-opus-5-5', '{"service_tier":"batch"}'::jsonb, 0.14, :'key') as settled;
reset role;
select 'BS13b. part 0: ' || status || ', made ' || made || ', solver rejected ' || solver_rejected || '; staged left ' ||
       (select count(*) from study_private.bank_items where job_id = :'j3') || '; holds left ' ||
       (select count(*) from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l3' and hold_until is not null) || ' (expect ready, 1, 1; 0; 0)'
  from public.study_question_batches where id = :'q3a';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j3', :'key')) as t3 \gset
select 'BS14. fall-back: ' || (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'step') || ' part ' || (:'t3'::jsonb -> 'row' ->> 'part_idx') || ' (expect write part 1)';
select public.study_bank_save(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'q', :'q3b', '{"kind":"mcq","question":"מה גורמת Disulfiram?","options":["הקאות","שינה","רעב","צמא","גרד"],
  "answer":0,"explanations":["כן [ש'' 12]","לא [ש'' 12]","לא [ש'' 12]","לא [ש'' 12]","לא [ש'' 12]"],"slides":[12],"topic":"Metronidazole","aspect":"adverse"}'::jsonb, :'key') is not null as bs14;
select public.study_bank_finish(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'q', :'q3b', 'ready', 0, 0, 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.05, null, :'key');
select 'BS14b. ' || public.study_bank_report(:'j3', (:'t3'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'step_done', '{}'::jsonb, :'key') || ', next: '
       || coalesce(public.study_bank_take(:'j3', :'key')::text, 'nothing') || ' (expect fallback, nothing)';
reset role;
select 'BS14c. the job: ' || state || ' (expect done)' from study_private.bank_jobs where id = :'j3';
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005';
select 'BS14d. Daniel sees the bank: ' || (select count(*) from public.study_questions where lecture_id = :'l3') || ' questions, '
       || (select count(*) from public.study_cards where lecture_id = :'l3') || ' cards, state ' || (public.study_bank_state(:'l3') ->> 'state')
       || ' (expect 2, 2, done)';

-- BS15: a meeting in 40 minutes: no time for a batch; written normally now.
reset role;
insert into public.study_meetings (group_id, day, starts_at, lecture_id, part_from, part_to)
values (:'g', (now() + interval '40 minutes')::date, now() + interval '40 minutes', :'l4', 0, 1);
update public.study_lectures set status = 'ready' where id = :'l4';
select id as j4 from study_private.bank_jobs where lecture_id = :'l4' \gset
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j4', :'key') ->> 'step') as s4 \gset
reset role;
select 'BS15. too close to the meeting: ' || :'s4' || ', mode ' || mode || ' (expect write, now)' from study_private.bank_jobs where id = :'j4';

-- BS16: the deadline passes while the batch runs: cancel, then write the rest.
reset role;
update public.study_lectures set status = 'ready' where id = :'l5';
select id as j5 from study_private.bank_jobs where lecture_id = :'l5' \gset
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j5', :'key')) as t5 \gset
select public.study_bank_report(:'j5', (:'t5'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'submitted', '{"stage":"write","msg_batch":"msgbatch_01TestLate"}'::jsonb, :'key') as bs16;
reset role;
update study_private.bank_jobs set deadline = now() - interval '1 minute' where id = :'j5';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j5', :'key')) as t5 \gset
select 'BS16. at the deadline: ' || (:'t5'::jsonb ->> 'step') || ' (expect cancel)';
select public.study_bank_report(:'j5', (:'t5'::jsonb ->> 'lease')::uuid, 'cancelling', '{}'::jsonb, :'key') as bs16b;
select 'BS16b. then: ' || (public.study_bank_take(:'j5', :'key') ->> 'step') || ' (expect poll: until the batch ends)';
reset role;
update study_private.bank_jobs set cancel_at = now() - interval '20 minutes', lease_until = now() - interval '1 second' where id = :'j5';
set role anon;
reset request.jwt.claim.sub;
select (public.study_bank_take(:'j5', :'key') ->> 'step') as s5 \gset
reset role;
select 'BS16c. cancelling took too long: ' || :'s5' || ', holds left ' || count(*) || ' (expect write, 0)'
  from public.study_question_batches where lecture_id = :'l5' and hold_until is not null;

-- BS17: the sweeper. A stalled job (15 kicks nobody took) gives up; a
-- deleted lecture's job is cancelled; kicks wait two minutes.
reset role;
update study_private.bank_jobs set lease_until = null, kicks_since_claim = 15 where id = :'j5';
select study_private.bank_dispatch() >= 0 as swept;
select 'BS17. stalled: ' || state || ', ' || error || ' (expect failed, stalled)' from study_private.bank_jobs where id = :'j5';
update public.study_lectures set deleted_at = now() where id = :'l4';
update study_private.bank_jobs set lease_until = null where id = :'j4';
select study_private.bank_dispatch() >= 0 as swept;
select 'BS17b. deleted lecture: ' || state || ' (expect cancelled)' from study_private.bank_jobs where id = :'j4';
select 'BS17c. the sweeper''s job: ' || count(*) || ' (expect 1: study-bank every 2 minutes)' from cron.job where jobname = 'study-bank' and schedule = '*/2 * * * *';

-- BS18: privacy. Members cannot read the private tables; anon may call only
-- the worker's five functions of this section, and they need the key.
set role authenticated;
set request.jwt.claim.sub = 'a1000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
do $$ begin perform 1 from study_private.bank_jobs; raise notice 'BS18. FAIL: a member read the jobs';
exception when others then raise notice 'BS18. ok: the jobs are not readable (%)', sqlerrm; end $$;
reset role;
select 'BS18b. anon may call: ' || string_agg(p.proname, ', ' order by p.proname) || ' (expect study_bank_finish, study_bank_input, study_bank_report, study_bank_save, study_bank_take)'
  from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
 where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname like 'study\_bank%' and has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'execute');
select 'BS-reg. B = ' || (public.study_schema() ->> 'B') || ' (expect 1)';
```

```sql
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--  Sections G and E · GS: the group plan, its days, a slip's price, the

-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
set role authenticated;

  array[:'l1'::uuid, :'l3'::uuid]) \gset

  from public.study_group_plans where id = :'gp';

exception when others then raise notice 'GS1b. %: (%)', case when sqlerrm = 'bad date' then 'ok' else 'FAIL' end, sqlerrm; end $$;

                                    null, null, 180, 600, 3, '09:00');
```

```sql
-- ── helpers (the owner's; members call them only through rv.raises) ──
create schema if not exists rv;
create or replace function rv.expect(p_label text, p_got text, p_want text) returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  if p_got is not distinct from p_want then raise notice '%. ok: %', p_label, coalesce(nullif(p_got, ''), '(empty)');
  else raise notice '%. FAIL: % (expect %)', p_label, coalesce(p_got, 'null'), p_want; end if;
end $$;
-- Runs p_sql as the caller and expects it to raise exactly p_want.
create or replace function rv.raises(p_label text, p_sql text, p_want text) returns void language plpgsql as $$
begin
  execute p_sql;
  raise notice '%. FAIL: it ran (expect "%")', p_label, p_want;
exception when others then
  if sqlerrm = p_want then raise notice '%. ok: refused (%)', p_label, sqlerrm;
  else raise notice '%. FAIL: % (expect "%")', p_label, sqlerrm, p_want; end if;
end $$;
create or replace function rv.as_user(p uuid) returns void language sql as $$
  select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', p::text, false) $$;
-- Moves the open round of a quiz p_secs into the past (the clock runs).
create or replace function rv.shift(p_quiz uuid, p_secs numeric) returns void language sql security definer as $$
  update public.study_quiz_rounds set opens_at = opens_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision),
                                      closes_at = closes_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision)
   where quiz_id = p_quiz and opens_at is not null and revealed_at is null;
  update public.study_quizzes set opens_at = opens_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision),
                                  closes_at = closes_at - make_interval(secs => p_secs::double precision)
   where id = p_quiz;
$$;
create or replace function rv.q_now(p_quiz uuid) returns uuid language sql security definer as $$
  select r.question_id from public.study_quizzes z join public.study_quiz_rounds r on r.quiz_id = z.id and r.idx = z.idx where z.id = p_quiz $$;
grant usage on schema rv to authenticated, anon;
grant execute on all functions in schema rv to authenticated, anon;
\echo '== review fixtures loaded'
```

```sql
\set ON_ERROR_STOP 1
```
